errors.ASSET_REFERENCED: This asset is still used by other records, so it cannot be deleted. Detach it from those records first.
errors.ASSET_FOLDER_NOT_EMPTY: This folder is not empty. Move or delete its subfolders and assets first.
errors.ASSET_FOLDER_NAME_CONFLICT: A folder with this name already exists here. Choose a different name.
errors.ASSET_FOLDER_CYCLE: A folder cannot be moved into itself or into one of its subfolders.
errors.ASSET_UPLOAD_NO_FILE: No file was uploaded. Choose a file and try again.
errors.ASSET_UPLOAD_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Files of this type cannot be uploaded to the asset library.
errors.ASSET_UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large: the largest file that can be uploaded is {maxFileSizeMb} MB.

errors.ASSET_FILE_MISSING: The file for this asset is missing from file storage.

errors.ASSET_PERMALINK_INVALID.uuid_shap: A permalink cannot look like an asset id.
